cause: Official PyTorch native bmm_outer_product dispatch invokes Triton, which needs a writable executable kernel cache.
observed_behavior: Model loaded on GPU; warmup returned 500, worker health became 503, API stayed not ready and retained durable warmup lease. No unknown generation was retried in the same epoch.
fix: Dedicated bounded /runtime-cache tmpfs with explicit exec; TRITON_CACHE_DIR/TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR/CUDA_CACHE_PATH/TMPDIR configured. No CUDA/PyTorch/Transformers replacement.
